records.excerpt: The official Police.uk locate-neighbourhood API finds the neighbourhood policing team responsible for a latitude and longitude and returns force and neighbourhood identifiers.
records.web_line_scope: official request parameter, example request, example response and response description

records.excerpt: The official Police.uk specific-neighbourhood API returns the neighbourhood name, centre point, force URL, locations and other team metadata for a force and neighbourhood identifier.
records.web_line_scope: official example request, example response and response description

records.excerpt: Data.police.uk is the official open-data site for crime and policing in England, Wales and Northern Ireland and provides a JSON API for police forces and neighbourhood teams.
records.web_line_scope: official home-page identity, API availability and open-data statement

records.excerpt: Data.police.uk states that its published data is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and identifies the Single Online Home National Digital Team as publisher for described datasets.
records.web_line_scope: official publisher, licence and API-interface sections
